ña: [Ña ña-akkharā, 41-luṃḥso akkharātiu့tvaṅa In byaññaḥ-ācoka  phracaso(tāluja)-cavaga pañcama-akkharā.mūraṅaḥkrañña့pā. Tipi,8,553+554+555 ña ña(pu) [ñā+a] (1) loudly sound. (Na) (2) Gold. (3) Guarded or controlled speech or action. (Ti) (4) Should be known. (5) Should be compared. (6) Can be known. (7) One who can be enjoyed.
ñatta: [Ñā+ta] (na) CL=7 [Ñāyateti ñattaṃ, to. Dhāna,ṭī.704-6.] Proximiy (or) Near, Edge (or) Near, Near (or) Beside (or) By the side of. Ñatta(na) [ñāta+tta] (A) One who is perception, knowing ( skill). (B) As one who is famous, Be fame ( rule over, surroundants, properties).
ñattajjhāpanna: [Ñatta+ajjhāpanna] (ti) CL=7 One who come close to the status of fame, One who is famous.
ñatti: [Ñā+ti] (thī) CL=7 [Ñapa+ti] (1) Killing. (2) Can be fond. (3) Grinding (or) Sharpening. (4) Be placed. [Ñatti(thī) [ñā+ṇāpe+ti. Ñāpanaṃ ñatti, nirutti.486.] ñata, Let them to know, Words which can be known others.
ñattianussāvana: [Ñatti+anussāvana] (na,thī) CL=7 Ñata, Kammavācā. (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to th ritual performed (or) Richly decorated book (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script). (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattianussāvanasampatti: [Ñattianussāvana+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment/completion of Ñata, Kammavācā. (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to th ritual performed (or) Richly decorated book (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script). (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiaparāmasana: [Ñatti+aparāmasana] (na) CL=7 Not considering Ñata, not reciting the Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñatticatuttha: [Ñatti+catutthā=catutthī] (ti) CL=7 The fourth time of Ñata (Kammavasa, kamma).(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood). (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to th ritual performed (or) Richly decorated book (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script).
ñatticatutthakamma: [Ñatticatuttha+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma which should be made by  kammavācā that is fourth times of  Ñata, Kamma which is the fourth times of Ñata, Kamma which is one time of Ñata which is three times of Kammavācā, Ñatticatutthakaṃ.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood). (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to th ritual performed (or) Richly decorated book (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script).
ñatticatutthakammavācā: [Ñatticatuttha+kammavācā] (thī) CL=7  It is kammavācā which is the four times of Ñata,  ñatticatutthakammavācā. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood). (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to th ritual performed (or) Richly decorated book (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script).
ñatticatutthakammaṭṭhānabheda: [Ñatticatutthakamma+ṭhānabheda] (pu) CL=7 It is the business of Ñatticatutthakaṃ  which is different from other.
ñatticatutthakammūpasampadā: [Ñatticatutthakamma+upasampadā] (thī) CL=7 Allowed to be ordained as a monk by Kamma which is reciting four times of Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñatticatutthaupasampadā: [Ñatticatuttha+upasampadā] (thī) CL=7 Allowed to be ordained as a monk by Kamma which is reciting four times of Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñatticatutthaupasampadākamma: [Ñatticatuttha+upasampadākamma] (na) CL=7 It is four times Ñata which is  upasampadakaṃ. ( upasampadakaṃ means [Vinayas] ordination rites).
ñattidosa: [Ñatti+dosa] (pu) CL=7 The sin of  Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattidukkaṭa: [Ñatti+dukkaṭa] (na) CL=7 Dukkaṭaāpata which is guilty of breaking the vinayas rules due to Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattidutiya: [Ñatti+dutiya] (ti) CL=7 It is the second time of Ñata. (Kammavācā, kaṃ). (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood). (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to the ritual performed (or) richly decorated (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script.)
ñattidutiyakamma: [Ñattidutiya+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma which is recited two times of Ñata (Kammavācā). Kamma which is recited two times of Ñata(Kammavācā),  Kamma which is recited one time of Ñata(Kammavācā),  ñattidutiyakaṃ.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood). (Kammavācā means selection from sacred Pali texts recited by monks according to the ritual performed (or) richly decorated (usually of lacquered tablets) containing a collection of such texts written in a square script.)
ñattidutiyakammavācā: [Ñattidutiyā+kammavācā] (thī) CL=7 (Kammavācā) which is recited two times of Ñata, Ñattidutiyakammavācā.
ñattidutiyakammaṭṭhānabheda: [Ñattidutiyakamma+ṭhānabheda] (pu) CL=7 The business of Ñattidutiyakaṃ which is different from other.
ñattikamma: [Ñatti+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma which is made by (recite ) Ñata, Ñattikaṃ. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattikammaṭṭhānabheda: [Ñattikamma+ṭhānabheda] (pu) CL=7 The business of Ñattikaṃ which is different from other.
ñattikappanā: [Ñatti+kappanā] (thī) CL=7 Judgment for Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattikhetta: [Ñatti+khetta] (na) CL=7 Period of Ñata, Time for reciting Ñata,The field of Nattikamma which is recited Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattikicca: [Ñatti+kicca] (na) CL=7 The matter of doing/acting/reciting Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattikittana: [Ñatti+kittana] (na) CL=7 To speak of wisdom; Recitation of the Dhamma
ñattikkhaṇa: [Ñatti+khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 The moment of reciting Ñata,  reciting Ñata moment, when reciting Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattikāla: [Ñatti+kāla] (pu) CL=7 When it is time to recite Ñata, when it should be recited Ñata. See - Ñattiokāsa. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiniṭṭhāna: [Ñatti+niṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 (1) The end of reciting Ñata. (2) (When) it is finished for reciting Ñata. See - Ñattiārabba.
ñattiokāsa: [Ñatti+okāsa] (pu) CL=7 The business of Ñata, when reciting Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattipariyosāna: [Ñatti+pariyosāna] (na) CL=7 The end of Ñata (or) End of reciting Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattipubbakatta: [Ñatti+pubbaka+tta] (na) CL=7 As it is foremost Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattirūpatta: [Ñatti+rūpa+tta] (na) CL=7 As a matter of Ñata. See - Ñattipubbakatta.  (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattisamatha: [Ñatti+samatha] (pu) CL=7 It is Ñata which is Samatha, The samatha which is to cease the dispute/riot that is Ñata. (Samatha means meditation to attain tranquility) (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattisampadā: [Ñatti+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment/completion of Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattisampanna: [Ñatti+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 It is completed with Ñata.  (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattisampatti: [Ñatti+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment/completion of Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattisampattisampanna: [Ñattisampatti+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 (Kamma) which is completed/fulfilled with Ñatti Sampatti. (Sampatti means attainment (or) well-being). (Ñatti means to be known (or) reciting Ñata (or) words which is to be known other).
ñattivibhāga: [Ñatti+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Criticized on Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattivipanna: [Ñatti+vipanna] (ti) CL=7 It has shortcomings/uncompleted Ñata, It is not perfected Ñata.(Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattivipatti: [Ñatti+vipatti] (thī) CL=7 Destruction of Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiārabbha: [Ñatti+ārabbha] (pu) CL=7 When you start to practice Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiṭhapana: [Ñatti+ṭhapana] (na) CL=7 Reciting Ñata, Reciting Ñata.  (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiṭṭhapaka: [Ñatti+ṭhapaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is reciting Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiṭṭhapana: [Ñatti+ṭhapana] (na) CL=7 Chanting Ñata, Reciting Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiṭṭhapanaka: [Ñatti+ṭhapanaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is reciting Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñattiṭṭhapitakāla: [Ñatti+ṭhapita+kāla] (pu) CL=7 When reciting Ñata, When have already recited Ñata. (Ñata means ritual announcement made at the inauguration of a Buddhist ecclesiastical undertaking such as ordination into monkhood).
ñatvā: [Ñā+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Know. (A) Have known. (B) Due to know. (C) Investigation and contemplation. (D) To weigh the pros and cons (or) To consider and contemplate, To decide.
ñatvāna: [Ñā+tvāna] (kri,vi) CL=7 [Jānātītiñatvāna. Nettivi.245.] To know. (A) Have known. (B) Knowing. (C) Due to know. (D) To consider and contemplate, To decide. (E) To distinguish and memorize.
